_comment: Rough, for-fun estimates. There is no official per-token figure from Anthropic. Edit these in the dashboard settings; overrides live in ~/.tokenburn/config.json.

sources.claim: ~0.3 Wh per typical chat query (assumes roughly 500 output tokens), i.e. ~0.6 mWh per output token -> 600 Wh per million output tokens
Median 0.34 Wh per query for frontier-scale (>200B) models on H100 nodes; long reasoning/agentic responses can be >10x
Input/prefill tokens cost far less energy than generated tokens; cache reads less still. The weights here are a deliberate rough ratio, not a measurement.
Water: on-site cooling ~0.2-2 L/kWh plus off-site electricity-generation water ~3 L/kWh in the US; 2 L/kWh here is a middle-of-the-road blended figure
